text: じしん　あったんだが

structure.jp: じしん　あったんだが

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a verb adds an explaining tone: 'the thing is...'. あったんだ = 'the thing is, I had it'.

patterns.name: 〜が
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a statement means 'but', and here the rest is left unsaid. あったんだが = 'I had it, but...'
